newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Bridge completes initial offering.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Bridge completes initial offering.

text.p: Chicago Bridge & Iron Co NV said Thursday it completed an initial public offering of 8.4 million of its common shares in the United States and Canada, and 2.1 million of its common shares outside the United States and Canada at a price of $18 a share.
All of the shares are being sold by Praxair Inc, the parent company of Chicago Bridge & Iron.
After completion of the sale, there will be 12,517,552 shares outstanding.
Underwriters were led by Credit Suisse First Boston, Goldman, Sachs & Co, Smith Barney Inc, and UBS Securities.
Founded in 1889, Chicago Bridge & Iron provides engineering and construction services for petroleum terminals, cryogenic storage facilities and elevated water storage tanks.
